<function name="OnDoubleClick" parent="DFileBrowser" type="panelhook">
	<description>
Called when a file is double-clicked.

<note>Double-clicking a file or icon will trigger **both** this and <page>DFileBrowser:OnSelect</page>.</note>
	</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<file line="297-L301">lua/vgui/dfilebrowser.lua</file>
	<args>		
		<arg name="selectedPanel" type="Panel">The panel that was double-clicked to select this file.<br/><br/>This will either be a <page>DListView_Line</page> or <page>SpawnIcon</page> depending on whether the model viewer mode is enabled. See <page>DFileBrowser:SetModels</page>.</arg>
<arg name="filePath" type="string">The path to the file that was double-clicked.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
